question: What proportion of all deaths is attributable to alcohol consumption?
answer: About 2.6 million deaths a year are attributed to alcohol. Worldwide, that is one person in every twenty who dies. The page shows 20 deaths and asks the reader to tap to mark how many alcohol causes.
move: Alcohol kills about 1 in 20 people: 2.6 million deaths a year.
